jobs.title: Data Solution Analyst (AI & Tools)
jobs.description: This is a hands-on role focused on analytics, automation and AI-enabled decision support across Network Operations. The organization is strengthening its AI-driven capabilities across Network Operations and seeking a Data Solutions Analyst (AI & Tools) to help turn complex operational data into trusted, decision-ready insights and tools.

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: As an AI/ML Engineer, you will enable the delivery of various AI projects which are strategic imperatives. This is achieved by spearheading engineering and productionisation of advanced analytics, artificial intelligence and machine learning models, algorithms and pipelines to solve complex business problems in close collaboration with the data science teams.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: As a Data Scientist, you will have the opportunity to manipulate large data sets, integrate diverse data sources, data types and data structures into solutions under management guidance.

jobs.title: 2027 EY Graduate Program – Data Analytics
jobs.description: At EY, your Data Analytics degree unlocks a range of exciting career paths to help you grow and thrive. You'll tackle real business challenges, collaborate with high-performing teams, and make a meaningful impact from day one. You'll be empowered with the latest technology, surrounded with high-performing teams.

jobs.title: 大模型算法研究员（具身智能方向）实习
jobs.description: 在具身智能领域开展研究，负责机器人数据的处理、具身模型网络的搭建与训练，探索具身智能领域最新研究进展，发表论文和专利，配合将具身模型部署到真实机器人上（包括机械臂、机器狗等）。要求硕士及以上学历，熟练使用Python/C++，熟悉PyTorch等框架，有ROS使用经验，有实际机器人调试使用经验者优先

jobs.title: 视觉/NLP/LLM算法暑期实习
jobs.description: 开发和实现自然语言处理模型和系统，包括对话引擎、知识问答引擎、文本分类、标签和实体抽取等，负责大模型相关的NLP算法研发。职位要求：本科及以上学历，每周实习不低于3天，优先考虑26届应届生；对自然语言生成算法原理有一定认知，熟悉Transformer、各类NLP主流模型技术方法；具备NLP大模型训练经验或ChatGPT等LLM模型应用项目经验者优先

jobs.title: 大模型算法实习生（Agent基础能力方向）
jobs.description: 负责大模型中智能体核心能力的研发与工程落地：提升语言模型和多模态模型在多轮交互、Function Calling、结合Agent框架的决策推理等场景中的稳定性与泛化能力；参与SFT和Agentic RL数据设计与建设，Function Calling训练数据建设；参与模型训练与微调，Agent系统协同开发

jobs.title: 大模型算法实习生（生命科学方向）
jobs.description: 参与科学智能中心生命科学基础大模型的研究与实现工作；参与多组学大模型的预训练算法研究，探索生命科学LLM（DNA、RNA、蛋白质、单细胞）的多模态对齐与训练；参与多组学大模型的下游任务应用研究，解决生物制药、生物育种、合成生物学等领域中的重大科学问题
